title: Export and playback keep to the In and Out marks
goal: A person can now mark an In and an Out on the timeline, but exporting still writes the whole video and play still runs to the end. Make Export write only the marked stretch when marks are set (with a way to export everything), the way Premiere does, so the marks are worth setting.
notes: Marks live on PhotonzDocument (markInMS, markOutMS, markedRangeMS in Sources/PhotonzCore/TimelineMarks.swift), set from the ruler/scrub-bar right-click menu and the Video menu (EditorState+TimelineMenus.swift). Export plans frames from 0..documentDurationMS in DocumentVideoExport.plan and writeVideo (EditorState+VideoExport.swift); the audio mix would need the same offset. untouchedRecording fast path must be skipped when a range is marked.
acceptance: With In and Out set, Export writes a file exactly as long as the marked stretch, starting at the In
The export sheet says it is exporting the marked stretch and offers the whole video instead
With no marks set, export is unchanged
A walk sets marks from the ruler right-click menu, exports, and checks the file length
Works at Next defaults with no switch turned on, and an audit written under queue/audits/ gives the try steps and a real picture
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Adversarial pass before building: Premiere's Export has a Range dropdown (Entire Source / Source In/Out) defaulting to In/Out when marks are set; no Photonz mock covers a range on the export sheet (export-share.html has none), so the sheet gets a Range row only when marks are set, segmented In to Out / Whole video, In to Out picked by default, and the shape line already says '0:04 of 0:10'. Frames must be exactly the window's frames at In+t, so export offsets the frame clock rather than trimming a copy of the document (trimming would re-base fades on titles cut at the In). Sound is the same mix windowed and shifted; a subtitle file beside the film is shifted too. Playback keeping to the marks (Premiere's Play In to Out) is not in the acceptance; export only here.

Shipped in 4c56dc6c. Walk export-keeps-to-the-in-and-out-walk (Next defaults, no flags) green: Set In/Out from the ruler menu at 4.0s/6.0s, sheet Range reads In to Out, in-to-out.mp4 runs 2.0s and its first picture has 0 of 16000 pixels unlike the document at 4000ms vs 204 unlike 0ms; Whole video writes 8.0s; with marks cleared no Range row and 8.0s. Scripts/test.sh: 10172 tests passed. Rough items: playback to the marks filed as play-in-to-out-plays-only-the-marked-stretch (title of this task promised it, acceptance did not). Left rough, not filed: the sheet always reopens on In to Out rather than remembering Whole video; the size estimate for the 2s stretch was 1.25x under (within 'about'). No mock draws a Range row, so it follows Premiere's Export.

Export writes only the In to Out stretch when marks are set (Range row on the sheet: In to Out / Whole video; sound and subtitle file shifted too); unchanged with no marks. Verified by export-keeps-to-the-in-and-out-walk at Next defaults (file lengths 2.0s/8.0s/8.0s, first picture matches the In) and the full test suite.
